what: null pass rate of p78_envelope_spec.json primary bar, simulated through p80_envelope.py --stage decide
why: p78 derived n>=135 from 1.645*sqrt(2p(1-p)/n) < 0.10 margin. The bar is read on (observed - half_width) and the observed difference carries its own SE, so the derivation is optimistic. Host-only, no card.
population: heavy-tailed synthetic at the spec worst-case rate p=0.5: half N(1.6,0.5), half N(6.0,4.0), floored at 0.1
verdict: the pre-registered n=144 is a coin flip on the null. No bar moves (p78 forbids it); n rises. 576 at the worst-case rate p=0.5.
cheaper_route: p=0.5 is the spec-chosen worst case and n scales as p(1-p). Run the R0 null at n=144 first, read the actual designability rate, re-derive n from the measured rate inside the pre-registered formula.
not_measured_this_pass: no card acquired; benchlock held by pxdesign-perf-p10 then perf-page-tt-cells for the whole pass
